summary: The legacy 21bl code already contains a reusable exact 59-variable QF_LIA integerization/model-extraction kernel, so BC2-02 does not need a new integer solver from scratch. However, the existing producer is semantically hard-wired to the 21az fixed-projection 3234-triple prism and its downstream 21bk/21bh/21bi/21bj locks. It is not a generic FULL178 producer. The missing unit is a source-locked adapter from an admissible FULL178 integral Picard target to the same exact 59D reduced-coordinate model (or an equivalent direct 48-support certificate), without importing 21az-only restrictions unless separately proved valid for the FULL178 target.

fresh_21bl_audit.scope: deterministic 56 fixed-projection representative sample only; not FULL178 numerical credit

minimal_generic_adapter_contract.input_identity: one admissible integral FULL178 Picard target with exact row/candidate provenance
minimal_generic_adapter_contract.required_model: 59 reduced variables plus exact integer-coefficient linear assertions defining that target in the retained Picard marking
minimal_generic_adapter_contract.forbidden_shortcut: do not import fixed-projection 21az/21bk/21bh/21bi/21bj bands merely because they make the legacy solver fast
minimal_generic_adapter_contract.sat_output: exact witness_r_reduced[59] with target identity and replayable source locks
